swift-openapi-runtime pin in the Swift codegen script (copied into the generated packages/contracts/gen/swift-client/Package.swift, which Renovate ignores)

packageRules.description: Toolchain pins in mise.toml bump only via Renovate, one PR each (15 §1.2, §9)
Stay current with no manual work: non-major (minor/patch) JS, Python and GitHub Actions updates auto-merge once CI is green. Later rules keep runtimes, mise, Android and SwiftPM manual
Security-critical scanners: patch updates auto-merge after CI
Major runtime bumps (node/pnpm/python/java) need an ADR — never automerge
Runtime pins (node/pnpm/python/java) mirror mise.toml (package.json#packageManager/engines, workers requires-python), which never automerges: keep every update type manual so the two never drift

Android (apps/android: version catalog gradle/libs.versions.toml + Gradle wrapper). Every bump needs `just android-deps-lock` on the branch (gradle.lockfiles + verification-metadata.xml; needs the Android SDK), so never automerge
prBodyNotes: **Android:** before merging, check out this branch and run `just android-deps-lock` (refreshes every `gradle.lockfile` and `apps/android/gradle/verification-metadata.xml`), review the diff, commit it, then `just android-check`. CI fails with dependency-verification errors until the locks are refreshed.

packageRules.description: Android toolchain: AGP, Kotlin (incl. the Compose compiler plugin), KSP, detekt and the Gradle wrapper move together (KGP/AGP compatibility table); never automerge
Compose BOM and the Compose artifacts in one PR
robolectric and its android-all(-instrumented) jar must move together (offline mode fails loudly on a mismatch)
iOS SwiftPM (apps/ios/Packages/*/Package.swift, exact pins): Renovate does not rewrite Package.resolved, so a human resolves it on the branch; never automerge
prBodyNotes: **iOS:** Renovate edits `Package.swift` only. Refresh the committed `Package.resolved` files on this branch (`just ios-test-packages` resolves them), review the resolved diff, then `just ios-check`.

packageRules.description: swift-openapi-runtime is pinned in apps/ios/Packages/Core/Package.swift and in tools/codegen/gen-swift.sh (the generated client): bump both in one PR and run `just generate`
prBodyNotes: **Contracts:** run `just generate` and commit the regenerated `packages/contracts/gen/swift-client/`, then `just generate --check`.
